one_liner_ko: 여러 프로젝트에 걸쳐 여러 Codex 에이전트를 지휘하는 데스크톱 커맨드 센터.
what_it_does_ko: CodexMonitor는 로컬 작업 공간 여러 곳에서 여러 Codex 에이전트를 지휘하는 Tauri 앱이다. 작업 공간마다 codex app-server를 띄워 스레드를 이어가고, 승인 처리와 모델·접근 모드 선택을 한 화면에서 한다. 브랜치별 worktree로 변경을 격리하고, diff·로그·GitHub 이슈와 PR을 앱 안에서 본다. OpenAI와 무관한 독립 서드파티 앱이며 베타 기간에는 보증 없이 제공된다.
key_features: 작업 공간 추가·유지·재연결과 최근 활동 대시보드
use_cases_ko: 여러 저장소를 오가며 Codex 에이전트로 빌드·리뷰·배포

evidence.quote: Orchestrate any number of Codex agents across any number of projects in a beautifully crafted
CodexMonitor is a Tauri app for orchestrating multiple Codex agents across local workspaces.
Codex Monitor runs one shared Codex app-server and restores your threads across workspaces.
Codex Monitor is an independent third-party application and is not affiliated with, endorsed by,
Add, persist, and reconnect workspaces with a live dashboard of recent activity.
Start threads, resume history, and handle approvals without leaving the main view.
Spin up per-branch worktrees for isolated changes and clean reviews.
Diffs, logs, branch controls, and Issues via gh built right in.
Pick models, tune reasoning effort, and lock in access modes per run.
Autocomplete skills, prompts, and file tokens in the composer.
Dictation with hold-to-talk shortcuts and live waveform (Whisper).
Optional remote backend (daemon) mode for running Codex on another machine.
Build, review, and ship across multiple repos without losing context.
